fact: Communications minister Raafat Hindy says the Digital Egypt platform currently provides more than 240 digital government services in 29 service bundles, with a target of 400 services in 2030.

Egypt's Ministry of Social Solidarity, with the Ministry of Communications and Information Technology, launched the first phase of a digital services system for foster families and care institutions on its social-care services platform, where citizens apply and track requests online.
Veto Gate's analysis says the Digital Egypt platform lets citizens complete many government procedures online, from registration and document upload to fee payment, without visiting the agency.

Vetogate reports the Digital Egypt platform offers real estate registration and notarisation services online, including powers of attorney, transaction lookup and office booking, some still needing a visit.

Egypt's Ministry of Investment and Foreign Trade says company incorporation applications can be made online on the GAFI portal, in line with Supreme Investment Council decisions on a unified electronic platform.
The government launched the Egypt Digital Platform in 2022, which delivers about 170 government services.

Egypt's Ministry of Foreign Affairs launched the pilot of a consular-services app for Egyptians abroad on 2026-10-21, covering 17 missions and consulates, in which citizens complete consular transactions and track their processing.
